steps.label: rung 2 (PsychENCODE)
steps.detail: using the significant-only release: absence from the file cannot be distinguished from tested-and-null, so rung 2 detection is an upper bound on the numerator with an assumed denominator.

steps.label: Bryois arm (D-007)
steps.detail: pseudobulk vs 8 cell types on 1 complete chromosome(s): [1]. Both arms are restricted to the same chromosomes, so the contrast is valid; it gains power as the remaining files arrive.

steps.label: restrict all rungs to the fixed gene universe
steps.detail: Tests on genes outside the 18,481-gene universe are dropped. The universe is the denominator (D-012), so a test on a gene it does not contain has nowhere to land.
